bootstrap: 5000 paired original-source cluster resamples, seed42; macro sequence and clip-weighted cluster CI; unadjusted descriptive validation CIs after checkpoint selection
mask: mean RGB abs(GT_future-last_observed)>0.05; fixed before evaluation; change proxy NOT object-motion truth
regional_lpips: mean spatial LPIPS map within mask; receptive fields cross boundaries; not standard cropped-image LPIPS
spatial_shuffle: three fixed permutations, identical across timestamps, content shuffled with positional coordinates held fixed
camera_only: remove spatial K/V after projection; one camera K/V per frame
spatial_only: remove camera K/V after projection; sixteen spatial K/V per frame
paired_permutation: permute content+coordinate K/V together; invariance sanity check
grouping_caveat: PO original metadata; legacy filename grouping may not establish physical scene independence
